import urllib.request
import json

# Function to search uniprot
def get_uniprot_info(gene_name, organism="9606"):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:{organism}+AND+reviewed:true&format=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    return data

for gene in ["TASL", "ADA", "CXorf21"]:
    data = get_uniprot_info(gene)
    print(f"Results for {gene}:")
    for entry in data.get("results", []):
        acc = entry["primaryAccession"]
        gene_names = [g.get("geneName", {}).get("value") for g in entry.get("genes", [])]
        mass = entry.get("sequence", {}).get("molWeight")
        length = entry.get("sequence", {}).get("length")
        protein_name = entry.get("proteinDescription", {}).get("recommendedName", {}).get("fullName", {}).get("value")
        print(f"  Accession: {acc}, Gene: {gene_names}, Name: {protein_name}, Length: {length} aa, Mass: {mass} Da ({mass/1000.0:.2f} kDa)")
